name: products
title: Products
description: Paginated product listing for category, collection and index pages: Root, Grid and Pagination. Root is context-aware — headless when given a `products` array (client-side paging), otherwise it fetches a page from the sveltekit-medusa-sdk products remote filtered by categoryId / collectionId / typeId / q / order. The page lives in the URL as a 1-based `?p=` param, so page 2 is linkable and crawlable. Grid defaults to 1/2/3/4 columns at base/md/lg/xl (override with `class`) and renders a Product.Card per product, or your own snippet per item, with an `empty` slot. Render-prop children expose { products, count, page, pageCount, loading, error }. No $effect (SSR-safe).

files.content: {@render children({ products: visible, count, page: currentPage, pageCount, loading, error })}

{#if ctx.products.length}
{#each ctx.products as product (product.id)} {#if children} {@render children({ product })} {:else} {/if} {/each}
{:else if !ctx.loading && empty} {@render empty()} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import * as PageNav from '$lib/components/ui/page-nav/index.js'
	import { getProductsContext } from './products-ctx.svelte.js'
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'

	let { class: className = '', children }: { class?: string; children?: Snippet } = $props()
	const ctx = getProductsContext()
</script>

<PageNav.Root page={ctx.page} pageCount={ctx.pageCount} pageParam={ctx.pageParam} class={className}>
	{#if children}
		{@render children()}
	{:else}
		<PageNav.Prev />
		<PageNav.Pages />
		<PageNav.Next />
	{/if}
</PageNav.Root>
